spec.title: Every block once

p.fact: This page uses every block of the documentation genre **once**, so the island backend has a subject with no gaps.

spec.p: Inline conventions ride inside a unit: `code`, **strong**, *emphasis* and [a link](/doc/com.example.docs/fixture-manual/latest/guide/every-block/).
